WITH 
players AS (
    SELECT player_id, player_name, batting_hand, bowling_skill
    FROM player
),

most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role) as rn
        FROM player_match
        GROUP BY player_id, role
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

total_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

total_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),

total_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),

highest_score AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, MAX(bs.runs_scored) as max_score
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

matches_30 AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as cnt_30
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored >= 30
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

matches_50 AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as cnt_50
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored >= 50
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

matches_100 AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) as cnt_100
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored >= 100
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

balls_faced AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY striker
),

total_wickets AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),

bowling_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

total_balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),

bowling_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler as player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as wickets,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs_given
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),

best_bowling_per_player AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        wickets as best_wickets,
        total_runs_given as best_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, total_runs_given ASC) as rn
    FROM bowling_per_match
)

SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(tr.runs, 0) as total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(tm.matches_played, 0) as total_matches_played,
    COALESCE(td.dismissals, 0) as total_times_dismissed,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(td.dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(tr.runs, 0) * 1.0 / td.dismissals ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(hs.max_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(m30.cnt_30, 0) as matches_30_runs,
    COALESCE(m50.cnt_50, 0) as matches_50_runs,
    COALESCE(m100.cnt_100, 0) as matches_100_runs,
    COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(tr.runs, 0) * 1.0 / bf.balls_faced * 100 ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(tw.wickets, 0) as total_wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(tbb.balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(bs.runs_conceded, 0) * 1.0 / tbb.balls_bowled * 6 ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbpm.best_wickets || '-' || bbpm.best_runs as best_bowling_performance
FROM players p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_runs tr ON p.player_id = tr.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_matches tm ON p.player_id = tm.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_dismissals td ON p.player_id = td.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score hs ON p.player_id = hs.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_30 m30 ON p.player_id = m30.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_50 m50 ON p.player_id = m50.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_100 m100 ON p.player_id = m100.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_wickets tw ON p.player_id = tw.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_stats bs ON p.player_id = bs.player_id
LEFT JOIN total_balls_bowled tbb ON p.player_id = tbb.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_per_player bbpm ON p.player_id = bbpm.player_id AND bbpm.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.
